preconditions.description: The length of the input string s must be between 1 and 1000 characters.

preconditions.expression: all(c.islower() or c.isdigit() or c == '.' for c in s)
preconditions.description: The input string s must consist only of lowercase letters, digits, and dots.
The input string s must contain at least one digit.

postconditions.description: The output must be the total price formatted according to the specified price format.
The total price must be at least one cent.
The total price must not exceed one million dollars.
